module TopModule (
  input clk,
  input areset,
  input bump_left,
  input bump_right,
  output walk_left,
  output walk_right
);

  reg [2:0] state;
    localparam IDLE = 3'd0,
               LEFT = 3'd1,
               RIGHT = 3'd2,
               LEFT2 = 3'd3,
               RIGHT2 = 3'd4;

  always @(posedge clk or posedge areset) begin
    if (areset) begin
      state <= IDLE
    end else begin
      case (state)
        IDLE: begin
          if (bump_left)
            state <= LEFT2
          else if (bump_right)
            state <= RIGHT2
          else
            state <= IDLE
        end
        LEFT: state <= bump_left ? LEFT2 : LEFT
        LEFT2: state <= bump_left ? LEFT2 : LEFT
        RIGHT: state <= bump_right ? RIGHT2 : RIGHT
        RIGHT2: state <= bump_right ? RIGHT2 : RIGHT
        default: state <= IDLE
      endcase
    end
  end

  assign walk_left = (state == LEFT || state == LEFT2)
  assign walk_right = (state == RIGHT || state == RIGHT2)

endmodule

module edge_detect(
	input clk,
	input rst_n,
	input a,
	
	output reg rise,
	output reg down
);

always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
	if (!rst_n) begin
		rise <= 1'b0;
		down <= 1'b0;
		a <= 1'b0; // Internal register for edge detection
	end
	else begin
		a <= a; // Update internal state
		rise <= (a == 1'b0) && (a <= 1'b1); // Rising edge detected
		down <= (a == 1'b1) && (a >= 1'b0); // Falling edge detected
	end
end

endmodule
